data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'enkrateia', meaning the ability to master one's desires and emotions, leading to self-control and continence. This virtue was highly valued in ancient Greek culture and Christianity. The name Encratia carries the meaning “Continence, self-control” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Encratia usually hope their child will grow to embody continence, self-control and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Encratia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Encratia" carries the cultural impact of ancient Greek virtue, emphasizing self-discipline and continence, which was highly regarded in Greece. By adopting this name, one is reminding themselves and others of the historical significance of self-control and its importance in shaping an individual's character and reputation.
data.spiritual_significance: Meanwhile, spiritually, the name "Encratia" is a reminder of the Christian virtue of chastity and self-mastery as fundamental aspects of one's spiritual journey. In the religious context, this name invokes the idea of living a life in accordance with God's will and to fulfill the call to purity and self-control. It's not only about physical chastity but also self-control in thoughts and emotions, ultimately leading to a closer relationship with God.
